(Tools: Glob, Grep, Read, WebFetch, WebSearch)

(Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ArtifactComments, ArtifactData, ArtifactCheck, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

1368	    session: Session, machine_id: str
1369	) -> tuple[int, str | None]:
1370	    """Audit one machine's incidents for lifecycle and responsibility closure.
1371	
1372	    Returns ``(total_count, broken_incident_id)``. Incidents are scanned in
1373	    ``(created_at, id)`` order. An incident is broken when:
1374	
1375	    * its ``event_id`` does not resolve to an existing decision event owned by
1376	      the path machine;
1377	    * its status history does not exactly match the status: ``open`` has no
1378	      history, ``acknowledged`` has exactly ``open -> acknowledged``, and
1379	      ``resolved`` has that edge followed by ``acknowledged -> resolved``;
1380	    * a history record's ``machine_id``, ``event_id``, or ``incident_id`` does
1381	      not match the incident;
1382	    * a responsibility record's ownership triple does not match, its ``party``
1383	      or ``role`` is empty after trimming surrounding whitespace, or its
1384	      trimmed ``(party, role)`` pair duplicates another record;
1385	    * a ``resolved`` incident has no valid responsibility record (the
1386	      responsibility closure is open).

1389	    bad value.

1391	    incidents = session.scalars(
1392	        select(AuthorizationDecisionIncident)
1393	        .where(AuthorizationDecisionIncident.machine_id == machine_id)
1394	        .order_by(
1395	            AuthorizationDecisionIncident.created_at,
1396	            AuthorizationDecisionIncident.id,
1397	        )
1398	    ).all()
1399	
1400	    machine_event_ids = set(
1401	        session.scalars(
1402	            select(AuthorizationDecisionEvent.id).where(
1403	                AuthorizationDecisionEvent.machine_id == machine_id
1404	            )
1405	        ).all()
1406	    )
1407	
1408	    for incident in incidents:
1409	        if incident.event_id not in machine_event_ids:
1410	            return len(incidents), incident.id
1411	
1412	        history = session.scalars(
1413	            select(IncidentStatusEvent)
1414	            .where(IncidentStatusEvent.incident_id == incident.id)
1415	            .order_by(IncidentStatusEvent.created_at, IncidentStatusEvent.id)
1416	        ).all()
1417	        expected_edges = _EXPECTED_INCIDENT_HISTORY.get(incident.status)
1418	        edges = [(entry.from_status, entry.to_status) for entry in history]
1419	        if expected_edges is None or edges != expected_edges or any(

1421	            or entry.event_id != incident.event_id
1422	            or entry.incident_id != incident.id
1423	            for entry in history
1424	        ):
1425	            return len(incidents), incident.id
1426	
1427	        assignments = session.scalars(
1428	            select(IncidentResponsibilityAssignment)
1429	            .where(IncidentResponsibilityAssignment.incident_id == incident.id)
1430	            .order_by(
1431	                IncidentResponsibilityAssignment.created_at,
1432	                IncidentResponsibilityAssignment.id,
1433	            )
1434	        ).all()
1435	        valid_pairs: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
1436	        for assignment in assignments:
1437	            party = assignment.party.strip() if isinstance(assignment.party, str) else ""
1438	            role = assignment.role.strip() if isinstance(assignment.role, str) else ""

1440	                assignment.machine_id != machine_id
1441	                or assignment.event_id != incident.event_id
1442	                or assignment.incident_id != incident.id
1443	                or not party
1444	                or not role

1453	        if incident.status == "resolved" and not valid_pairs:

1827

1829	    cause or effect does not resolve to an event of the path machine (missing
1830	    or owned by another machine) or when both endpoints are the same event.
1831	    Links that pass are added to a running edge set, and a link whose
1832	    cause -> effect edge would close a directed cycle among the edges scanned
1833	    so far is reported as broken. Read-only: issues no writes.

1836	        select(AuthorizationDecisionCausalLink)
1837	        .where(AuthorizationDecisionCausalLink.machine_id == machine_id)
1838	        .order_by(
1839	            AuthorizationDecisionCausalLink.created_at,

1856	            or link.cause_event_id not in machine_event_ids
1857	            or link.effect_event_id not in machine_event_ids

1860	        # Follow already-scanned cause -> effect edges from the new effect;

1989	    """Bounded breadth-first walk over one machine's causal links.
1990	
1991	    ``downstream`` follows existing ``cause_event_id -> effect_event_id``
1992	    edges; ``upstream`` reverses them. Only links belonging to the machine are
1993	    loaded and only targets that still exist as events of the machine are
1994	    followed, so the walk never crosses machines or enters dangling targets.
1995	    BFS plus a visited set seeded with the start makes the first encounter the
1996	    shortest distance and guarantees termination when links form a ring.
1997	    """
1998	    links = session.scalars(
1999	        select(AuthorizationDecisionCausalLink).where(
2000	            AuthorizationDecisionCausalLink.machine_id == machine_id
2001	        )
2002	    ).all()
2003	
2004	    existing_event_ids = set(
2005	        session.scalars(
2006	            select(AuthorizationDecisionEvent.id).where(
2007	                AuthorizationDecisionEvent.machine_id == machine_id
2008	            )
2009	        ).all()
2010	    )
2011	
2012	    adjacency: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
2013	    for link in links:
2014	        if direction == "downstream":
2015	            adjacency.setdefault(link.cause_event_id, []).append(link.effect_event_id)
2016	        else:
2017	            adjacency.setdefault(link.effect_event_id, []).append(link.cause_event_id)
2018	
2019	    distances = {start_event_id: 0}
2020	    queue: deque[tuple[str, int]] = deque([(start_event_id, 0)])
2021	    while queue:
2022	        current, depth = queue.popleft()
2023	        if depth >= max_depth:
2024	            continue
2025	        for neighbor in adjacency.get(current, []):
2026	            if neighbor in distances:
2027	                continue
2028	            # Skip link endpoints that do not resolve to an event of this
2029	            # machine (missing target or one outside the machine boundary).
2030	            if neighbor not in existing_event_ids:

2032	            distances[neighbor] = depth + 1
2033	            queue.append((neighbor, depth + 1))

2035	    distances.pop(start_event_id, None)

2047	    )

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import text

def client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv(
        "ACCOUNTABILITY_DATABASE_URL", f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'test.db'}"
    )

        yield test_client


def create_machine(client, external_id="machine-1", public_key="key-1"):
    response = client.post(
        "/machines",
        json={
            "external_id": external_id,
            "display_name": "Machine One",
            "public_key": public_key,
        },
    )
    assert response.status_code == 201
    return response.json()["id"]


def rotate(client, machine_id, public_key, expected_version):
    response = client.post(
        f"/machines/{machine_id}/rotate-key",
        json={"public_key": public_key, "expected_version": expected_version},
    )
    assert response.status_code == 200
    return response.json()


def rotations(client, machine_id):
    return client.get(f"/machines/{machine_id}/key-rotation-events")


def export_url(machine_id, from_created_at, to_created_at):
    return (
        f"/machines/{machine_id}/key-rotation-events/compliance-export"
        f"?from_created_at={from_created_at}&to_created_at={to_created_at}"
    )


def rid(n):
    return f"00000000-0000-0000-0000-{n:012d}"


T0 = "2026-03-01T00:00:00Z"
T1 = "2026-03-01T00:00:01Z"
T2 = "2026-03-01T00:00:02Z"
T3 = "2026-03-01T00:00:03Z"
T4 = "2026-03-01T00:00:04Z"

# Wide window for rotations minted by the API at wall-clock "now".

TO_WIDE = "2100-01-01T00:00:00Z"


def insert_rotation_row(
    client,
    machine_id,
    rotation_id,
    created_at,
    *,
    old_public_key="key-1",
    new_public_key="key-2",
    version=2,
    previous_rotation_id=None,
    content_hash="a" * 64,
    chain_hash="b" * 64,
):
    """Insert a rotation row directly with a fixed id and timestamp."""
    with client.app.state.engine.begin() as conn:
        conn.execute(
            text(
                "INSERT INTO key_rotation_events "
                "(id, machine_id, old_public_key, new_public_key, version, "
                "created_at, previous_rotation_id, content_hash, chain_hash) "
                "VALUES (:id, :machine_id, :old_public_key, :new_public_key, "
                ":version, :created_at, :previous_rotation_id, :content_hash, "
                ":chain_hash)"
            ),
            {
                "id": rotation_id,
                "machine_id": machine_id,
                "old_public_key": old_public_key,
                "new_public_key": new_public_key,
                "version": version,
                "created_at": created_at,
                "previous_rotation_id": previous_rotation_id,
                "content_hash": content_hash,
                "chain_hash": chain_hash,
            },
        )
